deficiencies.description: The rewrite inserts 'therefore', establishing a causal link between the niche not being very big and the tumour interfering with the bone marrow, which was not stated in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: This niche is not very big. This will interfere with your bone marrow
deficiencies.rewritePassage: This niche is not very big. The tumour will therefore interfere with the bone marrow

deficiencies.description: The rewrite states 'when the tumour occurs in a meningioma', turning 'meningioma' into an anatomical location where a tumour occurs. In the text and medically, a meningioma is itself a type of primary tumour, not an anatomical site.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: Only 10% of these deaths, generally, if they're occurring in things like the meningioma that I was telling you about or in the liver.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: Only 10% of deaths are generally caused in this way, for example when the tumour occurs in a meningioma or in the liver.

considerations.sourcePassage: Things like obstruction of the bile ducts in the liver interferes with digestion.
considerations.reason: The introductory sentence 'Other effects depend on the site' serves as a stylistic transition continuing the lecturer's earlier point that effects depend on 'the different settings in which they occur'.

considerations.sourcePassage: And things like if tumors in bones lead to erosion of that bone function, so you can get fractures
considerations.reason: The rewrite's phrasing 'erosion of the bone, so that fractures can occur' conveys the same meaning as the lecturer's 'erosion of that bone function'.

considerations.sourcePassage: Also ulceration, you saw that enormous cauliflower structure within the colon. This causes a lot of bleeding and can lead to anemia.
considerations.reason: The rewrite's phrasing 'the enormous cauliflower-like structure seen within the colon causes a lot of bleeding' preserves the lecturer's reference to the structure shown previously and its causal connection to bleeding.
